scenario_name: Agent avoids Phase 3 questions in first interaction
expected_behavior: Agent asks about party size, occasion, preferences — all Phase 1 and 2 topics. Does NOT ask about gaming budget, comp expectations, loyalty status, or how much they typically spend. Those questions are too early for a first-time guest
expected_behavioral_quality: In a first interaction, the agent NEVER asks Phase 3 questions (relationship-level: gaming budget, comp history, host relationship, personal financial signals). These feel invasive before trust is established. The agent stays in Phase 1 (foundation) and Phase 2 (preferences) only.

turns.user_message: First time here, what do you recommend?
turns.agent_response:

Pro tip: the portions are massive, so it is the best spot to fuel up while you get your bearings. Afterward, you can head over to the Wolf Den nearby to check the schedule for tonight's free live music. 

What brought you out to visit us today?

The Wolf Den is a must-see for free live music tonight, and the energy there is always electric. Insider tip: seating is first-come, first-served, so heading there a bit early is the best way to snag a spot close to the stage. After the music, you might want to check out one of our signature restaurants for a late-night bite. Are you leaning toward a high-energy show or a relaxing spa day?

For tonight, Ballo Italian Restaurant is hard to beat—it offers contemporary Italian soul with housemade pastas and risottos that guests love. It's located in the Casino of the Sky and is open from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM tonight, with a $$$ price range; I've got you with the details, and I'd recommend a reservation to secure your spot. Insider tip: the modern presentation of their traditional recipes makes every dish feel like a discovery. 

What kind of cuisine do you usually look for when trying somewhere new?

After your meal, you might enjoy heading over to the shops in the Sky for a little evening browsing.
